itinerary.notes: Fly Reykjavík to Gdańsk. Drop bags, then Długi Targ, the Crane and the Motława at dusk.
HEAVY DAY. Morning train, Kazimierz on foot, zapiekanka and Alchemia.
Arrive, then Marienplatz, Viktualienmarkt and a first beer garden.
Train from Munich; exchange block begins on arrival.
Chemin de la Corniche at golden hour and the Grund.
Bock Casemates first, train via Brussels, Graslei at dusk.
IC via Antwerp and Rotterdam, then De Pijp bars.
HEAVY DAY. Fly via Palma with a self-transfer and six bags.
HEAVY DAY. Drive via Córdoba; Mezquita on the 15:00 slot.
Drive via Osuna, Puente Nuevo and a quiet tapas round.
Setenil lunch under the rock, then free tapas in Granada.
HEAVY DAY. Drive via Guadix, then Halloween in Ruzafa.
HEAVY DAY. Drive via Peñíscola and return the minivan.
HEAVY DAY. Sagrada Família then fly to Venice.
HEAVY DAY. Day train over the Semmering line, market in the evening.
Short Old Town stop between Vienna and Budapest trains.
Rudas rooftop bath, Hospital in the Rock and House of Terror.
HEAVY DAY. EC train, then Žižkov tank Pilsner.
HEAVY DAY. Full train day via Hamburg; one late beer only.
Fly to Tallinn; old town and Christmas market.
Bus to Riga, Vecrīga and Folkklubs Ala Pagrabs.
Bus to Vilnius, Cathedral Square tree and Pilies Street.
Branch B: Christmas market and an Apfelwein tavern; fly home next day.
